rca of the issue: RCA (critical): In migration 20260817000000_business_daily_metrics.sql, variable available_minutes is initialized to 0 but overwritten directly by admin_report_available_minutes(...). If helper returns NULL for units lacking configured availability, available_minutes becomes NULL; response emits availableMinutes: null and can trigger frontend invalid_response (fail-closed mapper). Repro: inspect SQL assignment block and run regression test test_rpc_returns_safe_zero_when_no_available_minutes. Mitigation: assign with COALESCE(public.admin_report_available_minutes(...), 0).
